prompt: Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript service that implements passkey registration and authentication for a multi-tenant web application. Handle WebAuthn challenge creation and persistence, client-data validation, RP ID and origin checks, authenticator-data parsing, CBOR/COSE public keys, attestation conveyance and verification, signature counters, discoverable credentials, and replay-safe challenge expiry. Provide HTTP endpoints, an in-memory persistence adapter suitable for the example, and runnable registration and authentication examples using fixture payloads. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain which exact public APIs from each selected package are used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate. Keep the implementation focused on the protocol flow rather than application-scale boilerplate.

Implement a self-contained Node.js TypeScript confidential web client for OpenID Connect Authorization Code flow with PKCE. Discover the issuer metadata, generate and validate state, nonce, and PKCE values, exchange the authorization code, validate ID-token issuer, audience, signature, time claims, and nonce against rotating JWKS keys, and refresh tokens without losing session binding. Include login and callback routes, a minimal encrypted server-side session representation, logout handling, and a runnable example with configurable issuer and client values. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify the exact package APIs used, and give reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate; do not hard-code a vendor-specific identity provider.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript resource server and demonstration client for OAuth 2.0 Demonstrating Proof of Possession. The client must create an asymmetric key, produce DPoP proof JWTs with htm, htu, iat, jti, and public JWK claims, handle a server nonce challenge, and bind an access token to the JWK thumbprint. The resource server must validate the access token, DPoP signature and thumbprint, URI and method binding, clock window, nonce, and replay protection. Include one successful and several rejected example requests. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, name the exact selected-package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript identity-bridge example that acts as a SAML 2.0 service provider and exposes the core SCIM 2.0 user-provisioning interoperability needed by the bridge. Generate service-provider metadata, process signed SAML responses with audience, recipient, InResponseTo, time, and XML-signature checks, map attributes into a local user record, and demonstrate SCIM Users create, read, and patch operations with a SCIM error response. Support current and next identity-provider signing certificates for planned key rotation. Provide the core implementation files and representative local SAML and SCIM fixtures without unrelated application boilerplate or an external service. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, document the exact package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement a self-contained Node.js TypeScript federation gateway that accepts JWT access tokens from two independently configured OpenID Connect issuers. Perform discovery and JWKS retrieval, select keys by kid, validate issuer-specific audiences and algorithms, cache keys with bounded freshness, refresh safely on key rotation, and prevent an unknown issuer from controlling a fetch URL. Normalize accepted identities into a common principal while retaining issuer and subject. Include a deterministic local mock of both issuers that demonstrates overlapping key identifiers, rotation, cache expiry, and rejection cases. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, state the exact library APIs used, and give reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript core verifier for detached CMS/PKCS#7 SignedData documents. Parse PEM or DER input, attach detached content, validate the signer signature, build an X.509 chain to a configured trust anchor, enforce key usage and extended key usage, check certificate validity at a supplied verification time, and evaluate a provided CRL plus an optional stapled OCSP response without network requests. Return a structured report separating cryptographic, chain, revocation, and policy failures. Include small local valid and tampered fixtures or concise fixture-generation steps, and focus the code on the verification functions rather than application scaffolding. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript mTLS client credential loader for PKCS#12/PFX bundles. Accept a password-protected PFX, identify the leaf certificate and matching private key, order intermediate certificates, validate the chain and client-auth extended key usage, reject weak or expired credentials, and create an HTTPS agent for a test request to a local mTLS server. Add a rotation mechanism that atomically swaps to a newly validated bundle while in-flight requests continue using the prior agent. Include local fixture-generation steps and success and failure examples. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify the exact package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement a self-contained Node.js TypeScript S/MIME core utility that constructs and parses standards-compatible MIME messages and demonstrates CMS signing, signature verification, encryption for X.509 recipients, and decryption. Preserve essential MIME headers and canonical line endings, report signer certificate details, validate the chain against supplied trust anchors, and distinguish signature, certificate, and content errors. Use one representative sign-then-encrypt round trip plus a tampered-message fixture; provide the core functions rather than exhaustive mail-client workflows. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, document the exact package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript signing service that uses a PKCS#11 interface to a locally configured software or hardware security module without exporting private keys. Enumerate slots and tokens, open and authenticate a session, locate a key by label and identifier, create a PKCS#10 certificate signing request, and sign application digests with an explicitly selected mechanism. Handle session cleanup, PIN input through environment variables, concurrent requests, token removal, and mechanism mismatch errors. Provide a mockable adapter and a no-device unit-test path. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact package APIs and PKCS#11 mechanisms used, and provide reproducible setup and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript RFC 3161 timestamp client and core verifier. Hash an input artifact, construct a DER TimeStampReq with nonce, certificate request, and selectable digest algorithm, send it through an injectable transport, parse TimeStampResp status values, and verify the CMS token, message imprint, nonce, signer certificate chain, extended key usage, and generation time. Include one offline valid request/response fixture and one tampered-imprint test so no live TSA is required; omit unrelated HTTP-service boilerplate. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, state the exact ASN.1, CMS, and X.509 package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript core document pipeline that fills a small AcroForm PDF from JSON, embeds a Unicode font, flattens one selected field, attaches the source JSON, and completes a detached signature placeholder with a locally supplied PKCS#12 certificate. Reopen the result to verify representative field values, attachment integrity, byte-range coverage, and signature metadata without rendering or executing embedded content. Include one small local fixture and a tamper demonstration, focusing on the PDF, signing, and verification functions rather than application scaffolding. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify the exact APIs used for PDF editing, signing, and certificate handling, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement a self-contained Node.js TypeScript processor for Office Open XML DOCX files that replaces content controls from structured data, inserts an image with correct relationships and content types, and preserves existing comments, headers, footers, and unknown ZIP parts. Validate required ZIP entries and XML namespaces, prevent ZIP-slip paths and unsafe external relationships, then reopen the generated document to prove that relationships and substituted values are consistent. Use small programmatically created fixtures. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, document the exact ZIP, XML, and OOXML package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript core image-to-searchable-PDF pipeline. Process one oriented JPEG and one small multipage TIFF, honor EXIF orientation, report ICC and XMP metadata with a documented preserve-or-normalize policy, run selectable-language OCR, and place an invisible text layer while retaining page geometry. Emit extracted text and a metadata report, show bounded worker concurrency, and include representative orientation and OCR-coordinate assertions. State any required local OCR language data or native runtime explicitly; omit unrelated upload-service boilerplate. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, state the exact APIs used for metadata, imaging, OCR, and PDF creation, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript core archive inspector for ZIP, TAR/TAR.GZ, and 7z inputs. Use small format adapters behind one interface, detect format from content, list entries before extraction, enforce entry-count, expanded-byte, compression-ratio, and nesting limits, and reject absolute paths, traversal, escaping links, encrypted entries, and duplicate normalized paths. Stream accepted entries to a quarantined output adapter and produce a common manifest. Include one safe fixture and representative traversal and limit failures rather than a full upload service. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact archive and stream APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement a self-contained Node.js TypeScript EPUB 3 builder and validator. Assemble chapters, CSS, a cover image, package metadata, navigation document, manifest, spine, and container metadata into a conforming archive with the uncompressed mimetype entry first. Parse the completed EPUB to verify ZIP ordering, required files, unique identifiers, media types, internal links, XML namespaces, and referenced resources, while rejecting traversal and remote active content. Include a small two-chapter example and validation failure fixtures. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify the exact ZIP, XML, and HTML package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript EDI X12 service that parses an 850 purchase order, validates ISA/GS/ST control numbers and segment counts, maps parties and line items into typed JSON, and produces a corresponding 997 functional acknowledgment with accepted and rejected transaction-set details. Preserve delimiters detected from the interchange, support multiple transaction sets, and report syntax errors with segment positions. Include valid and invalid local fixtures and round-trip examples. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, document the exact selected-package APIs and X12 versions used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript UN/EDIFACT gateway that reads ORDERS messages, detects syntax level and separators from UNA, validates UNB/UNH references and UNT/UNZ counts, maps nested line items, dates, quantities, parties, and references into a normalized order, and generates a CONTRL acknowledgment describing accepted or rejected segments. Support multiple messages per interchange and release-character escaping. Include local D.96A-style fixtures with positive and negative cases. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify exact parser or schema APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement the core of a self-contained Node.js TypeScript AS2 sender and receiver for one locally simulated trading partner. Construct an EDI payload with MIME headers, apply S/MIME signing and optional encryption, send it over HTTP, verify the signature and decrypted content, and demonstrate a signed synchronous MDN plus the correlation data needed for an asynchronous MDN. Validate message identifiers, original-message-id, disposition, received-content-MIC algorithm and value, certificate chains, duplicate messages, and one timeout case. Include small local certificates and deterministic fixtures, omitting unrelated partner-management or persistence boilerplate. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact MIME, CMS, certificate, and HTTP APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript SOAP interoperability example from a small supplied WSDL fixture. Implement one client operation and a minimal local handler using WS-Security UsernameToken, an X.509 XML signature, timestamp and replay checks, and one binary attachment transferred with MTOM/XOP rather than inline base64. Validate a representative SOAP fault, namespaces, signature references, attachment content identifier, and content hash. Keep endpoints local and configurable and focus on the exact WSDL, signature, security, and multipart integration points rather than a general SOAP platform. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify the exact package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript core mail-interoperability pipeline that parses one raw RFC 5322 MIME message, streams an attachment with size and type limits, verifies DKIM using an injectable DNS resolver, optionally decrypts and verifies an S/MIME body, and serializes a normalized message signed with a configured DKIM key. Preserve representative internationalized headers, multipart nesting, canonical line endings, and original authentication results in an audit record. Include compact local DNS, certificate, valid-message, and tampered-message fixtures; omit mailbox, delivery-queue, and account-management boilerplate. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, document the exact MIME, DKIM, DNS, and S/MIME package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement the core of a self-contained Node.js TypeScript search example backed by local PostgreSQL with PostGIS and a vector extension. Store documents with text embeddings, geographic points, JSON metadata, and validity intervals; provide one parameterized hybrid query combining vector distance, full-text rank, radius, metadata, and time-validity predicates with stable pagination. Include focused migrations and indexes, one transaction-safe ingestion function, a deterministic embedding stub, and concise setup SQL naming the required extensions. Provide representative integration assertions rather than a complete HTTP service. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify exact database and vector APIs used, and provide reproducible local installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript columnar-data converter that streams newline-delimited JSON events into Apache Arrow record batches and Parquet files, preserving nullable fields, timestamps with time zones, decimals, nested lists, and dictionary-encoded categories. Read the Parquet output back in bounded memory, select columns, filter a time range, and emit Arrow IPC stream data plus a schema and row-count report. Include deterministic fixtures and round-trip assertions for nulls and precision. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact Arrow and Parquet APIs used and their interoperability, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript Avro event producer and consumer with a local schema-registry adapter. Define two compatible schema versions using records, enums, unions, defaults, logical timestamp and decimal types, assign schema identifiers, encode messages with a registry wire envelope, and resolve older writer schemas against the current reader schema. Enforce backward-compatibility checks before registration and demonstrate compatible evolution, rejected breaking changes, and unknown schema identifiers without contacting an external registry. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify exact Avro and compatibility APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement the core of a self-contained Node.js TypeScript PostgreSQL transactional-outbox and change-data-capture consumer. In one transaction, update an aggregate and append a versioned outbox event; map committed changes from a logical replication slot through a mockable adapter; publish them to a local broker abstraction; and record idempotent consumer offsets so restart does not duplicate a business effect. Preserve transaction boundaries and per-aggregate ordering, and demonstrate one poison-event path. Provide focused migrations and one deterministic crash-and-restart test without a hosted service; omit unrelated broker administration and retention services. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact PostgreSQL, replication, serialization, and queue APIs used, and provide reproducible setup and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build the core of a self-contained Node.js TypeScript time-series example for local PostgreSQL with a time-series extension. Ingest a small batch of sensor readings with tags, event time, ingestion time, and quality flags using idempotent writes; provide focused hypertable, retention, compression, and continuous-aggregate definitions; and implement one parameterized gap-filled hourly query with last-observation carry-forward and time-zone-aware boundaries. Include one late-arrival example and concise synthetic-data assertions rather than a complete service. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify exact client and time-series database APIs or SQL features used, and provide reproducible local installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create two small self-contained Node.js TypeScript HTTP services that demonstrate OpenTelemetry traces, one request-duration metric, and correlated structured logs. Propagate W3C trace context and baggage across one outbound request, create meaningful client/server spans and error status, attach bounded-cardinality attributes, and show configurable OTLP export with graceful shutdown. Include an in-memory test-exporter example proving the parent-child relationship and log correlation without an external collector. Provide only the core service and telemetry setup files, not a general observability platform. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact OpenTelemetry APIs and instrumentation packages used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement a self-contained Node.js TypeScript core distributed-lease module using three simulated independent Redis nodes. Acquire a bounded-TTL lease with a unique ownership token, drift allowance, quorum decision, renewal, and compare-and-delete release; issue a monotonically increasing fencing token and show a protected resource rejecting one stale holder. Handle one partial-failure case, delayed responses, and renewal loss through a mockable Redis adapter. Include focused deterministic concurrency tests for acquisition, stale fencing, and lost renewal rather than a full service. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify exact Redis and distributed-lock package APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Build a self-contained Node.js TypeScript job-processing service with a Redis-backed queue. Enqueue idempotent payment-notification jobs, process them with bounded concurrency, exponential retry and jitter, distinguish retryable from terminal errors, move exhausted jobs to a dead-letter flow, and support safe operator replay without repeating completed business effects. Propagate trace context through job metadata and link producer and consumer spans. Include deterministic tests for duplicate delivery, worker crash, retry exhaustion, and dead-letter replay. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, document the exact queue, Redis, and OpenTelemetry APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Create a self-contained Node.js TypeScript distributed caching layer for three simulated API instances using Redis. Implement cache-aside reads, versioned keys, stale-while-revalidate, request coalescing to prevent stampedes, negative caching, and atomic compare-and-set updates. Publish invalidation events, recover from missed pub-sub messages with version checks, and degrade predictably when Redis is unavailable. Emit traces and metrics for hit state, coalescing, invalidation lag, and backend calls without high-cardinality labels. Include deterministic multi-instance tests. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, identify exact cache, Redis, pub-sub, and telemetry APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and example commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.

Implement a self-contained Node.js TypeScript core leader-election and work-coordination module using an etcd-compatible API. Campaign under a lease, renew it, observe a leadership change, fence writes by election revision, assign a small fixed set of shards among live members, and demonstrate one rebalance after member loss without duplicate shard commits. Handle watch reconnection after compaction, lease loss, cancellation, and graceful resignation at the core API boundaries. Instrument election latency and leader changes with OpenTelemetry and provide a deterministic in-memory adapter with representative failover tests. Include a complete package.json with exact dependency versions and scripts, explain the exact coordination and telemetry APIs used, and provide reproducible installation and execution commands. Use suitable npm packages where appropriate.
